label: The Ascent (high-ticket closer)
about: For scouting companies that sell high-ticket offers and might hire a commission closer. You scout them by hand (search, YouTube, people who already closer for them) and paste their websites. Each signal found is a reason to approach them; there is no 'gap' to fix. It mirrors the Ascent target-company score: a visible price of $3,000+, an application or booking page, closers or setters being hired, content going out. Warnings (income promises, regulated lanes) mean: read it carefully before you approach. Public pages only.

opener: Hi {business} team, I noticed {gap_line}. I'm {sender}: I close high-ticket offers on commission only. I recorded a short mock call selling an offer like yours so you can judge my close before we talk. Want me to send it? If it's not a fit, just say so and I won't follow up.
